31091.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Paket menejer — dasturni repo'dan yuklaydi, **bog'liqliklarni** (dependency) o'zi hal qiladi, o'rnatadi, yangilaydi va o'chiradi. Debian/Ubuntu'da **apt**, RHEL/Fedora/Rocky'da **dnf** (`yum` — uning eski nomi, RHEL 8+ da `yum` = dnf'ga symlink).

**Nega kerak:** Nginx'ni qo'lda o'rnatish — o'nlab kutubxona, to'g'ri versiyalar, config joylari, systemd unit. Paket menejer buni bitta buyruqda qiladi va keyin xavfsizlik yangilanishlarini ham yetkazadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
apt install nginx
  -> repo index (qaysi versiya, qanday dependency)
  -> resolver: nginx + libssl3 + libpcre2 ...
  -> .deb fayllarni yuklash, GPG imzo tekshiruvi
  -> dpkg o'rnatadi, postinst script (systemd unit yoqiladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y nginx
apt search nginx; apt show nginx
sudo apt remove nginx        # config qoladi
sudo apt purge nginx         # config ham o'chadi

# RHEL/Rocky/Fedora
sudo dnf install -y nginx
dnf search nginx; dnf info nginx
sudo dnf remove nginx
dnf history                  # nima qachon o'rnatilgan, undo mumkin
```
Boshqalar: Alpine — `apk add`, Arch — `pacman -S`, openSUSE — `zypper in`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `apt update` qilmasdan `install` — eski index, "404 Not Found" yoki eski versiya.
- Distro repo'dagi versiya eski bo'lishi mumkin (barqarorlik uchun) — yangisi kerak bo'lsa rasmiy upstream repo.
- Turli manbadan (`.deb` qo'lda + repo) aralash o'rnatish — dependency to'qnashuvi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod serverga qo'lda `apt install` emas — Ansible yoki image build (Packer/Dockerfile) ichida, versiya qotirilgan holda. Shunda har server bir xil.

31092.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `apt update` — repo'lardan **paketlar ro'yxatini** (index) yangilaydi, hech narsa o'rnatmaydi. `apt upgrade` — o'rnatilgan paketlarni shu ro'yxatdagi yangi versiyalarga **yangilaydi**. `apt full-upgrade` — kerak bo'lsa paket o'chiradi yoki yangi dependency qo'shadi.

**Taqqoslash:**
| Buyruq | Nima qiladi | Paket o'chiradimi |
|---|---|---|
| `apt update` | index yuklaydi (`/var/lib/apt/lists`) | yo'q |
| `apt upgrade` | yangilaydi, yangi paket qo'shishi mumkin | yo'q |
| `apt full-upgrade` | to'liq yangilash, conflict'larni hal qiladi | ha |
| `apt-get upgrade` | yangi paket ham qo'shmaydi (eski xulq) | yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo apt update
#  Hit:1 http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu noble InRelease
#  23 packages can be upgraded. Run 'apt list --upgradable' to see them.
apt list --upgradable
sudo apt upgrade
#  The following packages have been kept back: linux-generic
sudo apt full-upgrade       # kept back'larni ham
```
"kept back" — yangilash yangi paket o'rnatish yoki o'chirishni talab qiladi, `upgrade` buni qilmaydi.

dnf'da: `dnf check-update` (faqat ko'rish), `dnf upgrade` — metadata avtomatik yangilanadi (`metadata_expire`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `update` ni unutish — upgrade "hamma narsa yangi" deydi, aslida index eski.
- Prod'da ko'r-ko'rona `full-upgrade` — kernel, libc, DB yangilanib, servis to'xtashi mumkin.
- Kernel/libc yangilanishi reboot yoki restart'siz to'liq kuchga kirmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da yangilash = o'zgarish: avval staging, keyin canary guruh, keyin qolgani. Va `needrestart` bilan qaysi servislar eski kutubxonani ishlatayotganini tekshir.

31093.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **dpkg** / **rpm** — past daraja: bitta lokal paket faylini o'rnatadi/so'raydi, dependency'ni **hal qilmaydi** (faqat yo'qligini aytadi). **apt** / **dnf** — ular ustidagi yuqori daraja: repo'dan yuklaydi, dependency daraxtini hal qiladi, keyin dpkg/rpm'ni chaqiradi.

**Qatlamlar:**
```
apt  (repo, resolver, yuklash)       dnf  (repo, resolver)
  |                                     |
dpkg (o'rnatish, DB: /var/lib/dpkg)   rpm (o'rnatish, rpmdb)
```

**Amalda — so'rov buyruqlari:**
| Savol | Debian | RHEL |
|---|---|---|
| o'rnatilganlar | `dpkg -l` | `rpm -qa` |
| paket fayllari | `dpkg -L nginx` | `rpm -ql nginx` |
| fayl qaysi paketdan | `dpkg -S /usr/sbin/nginx` | `rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx` |
| paket fayli ichi | `dpkg -c x.deb` | `rpm -qlp x.rpm` |
| fayllar o'zgarganmi | `dpkg --verify nginx` | `rpm -V nginx` |

```bash
sudo dpkg -i pkg.deb            # dependency yo'q bo'lsa xato:
#  dpkg: dependency problems prevent configuration
sudo apt -f install             # yetishmayotganlarni tortib keladi
sudo apt install ./pkg.deb      # yaxshiroq: bir qadamda (./ shart)
sudo dnf install ./pkg.rpm
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `apt install pkg.deb` (`./` siz) — apt uni repo'dagi paket nomi deb qidiradi.
- `rpm -i --nodeps` — dependency'ni chetlab o'tadi, keyin sinish garantiya.
- `rpm -V` chiqishidagi `5` (checksum), `M` (mode) belgilari — fayl qo'lda o'zgartirilgan; intrusion tekshiruvida foydali.

**Senior nuqta:** `dpkg -S` / `rpm -qf` incident paytida juda foydali: "bu fayl qayerdan keldi?" — paketga tegishli bo'lmasa, uni kim va qanday qo'ygani savol tug'diradi.

31094.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kalit alohida faylga (`/etc/apt/keyrings/`) saqlanadi va repo qatori `signed-by=` bilan **faqat shu kalitga** bog'lanadi. Imzo muhim, chunki u paket haqiqatan repo egasidan kelgani va yo'lda (mirror, proxy, MITM) **o'zgartirilmagani**ni kafolatlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
repo egasi: Release faylini private key bilan imzolaydi
  Release -> har Packages faylining SHA256 -> har .deb SHA256
apt: public key bilan Release imzosini tekshiradi -> hash zanjiri
  -> bitta bayt o'zgarsa: "NO_PUBKEY" / "BADSIG" / hash mismatch
```

**Amalda (Debian/Ubuntu):**
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://example.com/key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg] https://example.com/apt stable main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ex.list
sudo apt update
```
Yangi deb822 format (`.sources`):
```
Types: deb
URIs: https://example.com/apt
Suites: stable
Components: main
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg
```
RHEL:
```ini
# /etc/yum.repos.d/ex.repo
[ex]
baseurl=https://example.com/rpm
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://example.com/key.asc
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `apt-key add` deprecated (Debian 12 / Ubuntu 22.04+ da ogohlantirish, keyinroq olib tashlangan): kalit **barcha** repo'larga ishonchli bo'lardi — bitta repo kaliti boshqa repo nomidan paket imzolay olardi.
- `[trusted=yes]` yoki `gpgcheck=0` — imzoni o'chirish, hech qachon prod'da.
- Kalitni HTTP orqali yuklash — kalitning o'zi almashtirilishi mumkin; fingerprint'ni tekshir: `gpg --show-keys ex.gpg`.

**Senior nuqta:** Uchinchi tomon repo — supply chain'ga yangi ishonch nuqtasi. Iloji bo'lsa internal mirror orqali o'tkaz va fingerprint'ni config management'da qotir.

31095.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Aniq versiyani o'rnatib (`apt install pkg=ver`), keyin **hold** qilasan (`apt-mark hold pkg`) — `apt upgrade` uni tegmaydi. RHEL'da `dnf versionlock`. Yanada nozik nazorat uchun apt **pinning** (`/etc/apt/preferences.d/`).

**Nega kerak:** Postgres 16.4 ishlayapti. Avtomatik upgrade 16.5 yoki boshqa repo'dan major versiya olib keldi — restart, mos kelmaslik, downtime. DB, kernel, container runtime kabi paketlarni ongli yangilash kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
apt-cache policy postgresql-16          # mavjud versiyalar
sudo apt install postgresql-16=16.4-1.pgdg22.04+1
sudo apt-mark hold postgresql-16
apt-mark showhold
sudo apt-mark unhold postgresql-16      # yangilash vaqti kelganda
```
Pinning (masalan, faqat security origin'dan):
```
# /etc/apt/preferences.d/pg
Package: postgresql-16
Pin: version 16.4*
Pin-Priority: 1001
```
RHEL:
```bash
sudo dnf install 'dnf-command(versionlock)'
sudo dnf versionlock add kernel-5.14.0-427*
dnf versionlock list
```
Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl=8.5.0-2ubuntu10.4
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hold qilingan paket xavfsizlik yangilanishlarini ham olmaydi — unutilsa, CVE'li qoladi.
- Distro repo eski versiyalarni o'chirib yuboradi — Dockerfile'dagi qotirilgan versiya bir oydan keyin "not found" bo'ladi. Snapshot mirror (`snapshot.debian.org`, internal repo) kerak.
- Hold dependency'larni qotirmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Pin — "hech qachon yangilama" emas, "ongli yangila". Har hold'ga sabab va review sanasini yoz (config management'da izoh), aks holda u texnik qarzga aylanadi.

31096.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `update`, `install` va tozalashni **bitta `RUN`** da qil, `--no-install-recommends` bilan, oxirida `/var/lib/apt/lists/*` ni o'chir. Skript/Dockerfile'da `apt` emas `apt-get` ishlat.

**Nega bitta layer:** Docker har `RUN` ni alohida keshlaydi:
```
RUN apt-get update          <- keshlanadi (3 oy oldingi index)
RUN apt-get install curl    <- keyin qo'shilgan paket eski index bilan
                               -> 404 yoki eski, CVE'li versiya
```
Bitta `RUN` da `install` qatori o'zgarsa, `update` ham qayta ishlaydi.

**To'g'ri namuna:**
```dockerfile
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates \
      curl \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
BuildKit kesh bilan (tezroq rebuild, image'ga tushmaydi):
```dockerfile
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl
```

**Har qism nega:**
| Qism | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `apt-get` | barqaror CLI; `apt` "unstable interface" ogohlantiradi |
| `-y` | interaktiv savol yo'q |
| `--no-install-recommends` | keraksiz paketlar yo'q — kichik image, kam CVE |
| `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive` (`ARG`) | tzdata kabi savollarda osilmaydi; `ENV` emas, runtime'ga qolmasin |
| `rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*` | ~30-50 MB index image'da qolmaydi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tozalashni alohida `RUN rm ...` da qilish — oldingi layer'da fayllar baribir qoladi.
- `ca-certificates` ni unutish — `curl https://` ishlamaydi.
- `apt-get upgrade` ni Dockerfile'da ishlatish — reproducibility buziladi; base image'ni yangila.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi apt — umuman yo'q apt: multi-stage build, runtime stage distroless yoki `scratch`. Build tool'lar faqat builder stage'da qoladi.

31097.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dinamik linker (`ld.so`) dastur talab qilgan `.so` kutubxonani **topa olmayapti**: kutubxona o'rnatilmagan, boshqa versiyasi bor (soname mos emas) yoki standart bo'lmagan yo'lda va linker keshida yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
./app ishga tushadi
  -> ELF: NEEDED libssl.so.3
  -> ld.so qidiradi: RPATH/RUNPATH -> LD_LIBRARY_PATH
     -> /etc/ld.so.cache (ldconfig) -> /lib, /usr/lib
  -> topilmadi: "error while loading shared libraries:
     libssl.so.3: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory"
```

**Diagnostika:**
```bash
ldd /usr/local/bin/app | grep 'not found'
#   libssl.so.3 => not found
ldconfig -p | grep libssl          # keshda nima bor (masalan faqat libssl.so.1.1)
apt-file search libssl.so.3        # Debian: qaysi paketda -> libssl3
dnf provides '*/libssl.so.3'       # RHEL
readelf -d app | grep -E 'NEEDED|RUNPATH'
```

**Tuzatish:**
```bash
sudo apt install libssl3                         # yetishmagan paket
echo /opt/vendor/lib | sudo tee /etc/ld.so.conf.d/vendor.conf
sudo ldconfig                                    # custom yo'l
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/vendor/lib ./app            # faqat sinov uchun
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ldd` ishonchsiz binar ustida xavfli — u dasturni qisman ishga tushirishi mumkin; shubhali faylga `readelf -d` / `objdump -p`.
- `libssl.so.1.1` ni `libssl.so.3` deb symlink qilish — ABI boshqa, crash yoki xavfsizlik muammosi.
- `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` ni global (`/etc/environment`) qilish — boshqa dasturlar noto'g'ri kutubxonani yuklaydi.
- Alpine (musl) image'da glibc uchun build qilingan binar — xuddi shu xato, chunki `ld-linux` yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu muammo sinfini butunlay yo'q qilish: Go'da `CGO_ENABLED=0` static binar, yoki container'da build va runtime image bir xil distro/versiyada bo'lsin.

31098.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Asosiy farq — **bundled vs shared**. Distro paketlari (.deb/.rpm) umumiy kutubxonalarni ishlatadi, patch bir joyda. **Snap**, **Flatpak**, **AppImage** dasturni bog'liqliklari bilan birga "qadoqlaydi" — har qanday distro'da ishlaydi, lekin har biri o'z kutubxona nusxasini olib yuradi.

**Taqqoslash:**
| | Distro paket | Snap | Flatpak | AppImage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kim tarqatadi | distro maintainer | Canonical Store | Flathub (va boshqalar) | muallif, istalgan joy |
| Kutubxonalar | shared | bundled + base snap | bundled + runtime | to'liq bundled |
| Yangilanish | apt/dnf | avtomatik (majburiy) | `flatpak update` | qo'lda |
| Sandbox | yo'q | AppArmor confinement | bubblewrap portallar | yo'q |
| Asosiy joy | server + desktop | Ubuntu, server ham | desktop | desktop, portable |

**Amalda:**
```bash
snap list; snap info lxd; sudo snap refresh --hold=24h lxd
flatpak install flathub org.gimp.GIMP
chmod +x App.AppImage && ./App.AppImage
mount | grep squashfs        # har snap — loop squashfs mount
```

**Trade-off:**
- Shared: OpenSSL'da CVE — bitta paket yangilanadi, hamma tuzaladi. Lekin versiya distro bilan bog'liq.
- Bundled: yangi versiya tez keladi, lekin CVE patch'i har dastur muallifiga bog'liq; disk ko'proq ketadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Snap avtomatik yangilanishi serverda kutilmagan restart (`snap refresh` oynasini sozla: `snap set system refresh.timer=...`).
- Snap confinement fayllarga kirishni cheklaydi — `/srv` dagi faylni ochmasligi mumkin.
- AppImage imzosiz yuklab olish — supply chain xavfi.

**Senior nuqta:** Serverda: distro paket yoki container image. Bundled formatlar desktop uchun qulay; server'da ular ikkinchi paket menejer va ikkinchi yangilanish siyosatini olib keladi.

31099.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Dependency hell** — ikki komponent bitta kutubxonaning **mos kelmaydigan** versiyalarini talab qiladi (A -> lib v1, B -> lib v2). Yechimlar: **SemVer** bilan mos versiyalarni aniqlash, **lock fayl** bilan qotirish, **izolyatsiya** (container, venv), distro'da **soname** orqali bir nechta major'ni parallel saqlash.

**SemVer:** `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
```
2.4.1 -> 2.4.2   PATCH: bug fix, xavfsiz
2.4.1 -> 2.5.0   MINOR: yangi funksiya, orqaga mos
2.4.1 -> 3.0.0   MAJOR: buzuvchi o'zgarish
"^2.4.1" = >=2.4.1 <3.0.0
```

**Muammo misoli:**
```
app
 +-- libA 1.x -> libX ^1.2
 +-- libB 3.x -> libX ^2.0      -> X ning bitta versiyasi ikkalasini qondirmaydi
```

**Yechimlar:**
| Usul | Qanday |
|---|---|
| Lock fayl | `go.sum`, `package-lock.json`, `poetry.lock` — har build bir xil |
| Izolyatsiya | container, `venv` — har ilova o'z versiyasi |
| Soname | `libssl.so.1.1` va `libssl.so.3` yonma-yon o'rnatiladi |
| Upgrade | eskirgan libA ni yangilash yoki almashtirish |
| Go MVS | eng kichik talab qilingan versiya, major — boshqa import yo'li (`/v2`) |

```bash
go mod graph | grep libX       # kim qaysi versiyani talab qiladi
npm ls libX
pipdeptree -r -p libX
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lock faylni commit qilmaslik — CI va prod boshqa versiya oladi.
- SemVer — va'da, kafolat emas; MINOR ham sindirishi mumkin. Testlar shart.
- `--force`/`--legacy-peer-deps` bilan muammoni yashirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Dependency soni — risk. Har yangi kutubxona: maintenance, CVE, hell ehtimoli. Kichik foydali kod uchun kutubxona olib kirishdan oldin o'zing yozish narxini sol; Renovate/Dependabot bilan kichik, tez-tez yangilash katta sakrashlardan xavfsizroq.

31100.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Foyda — xavfsizlik patch'lari soatlar ichida, odam unutmasdan o'rnatiladi. Xavf — kutilmagan restart, regressiya, butun flot bir vaqtda sinishi. Muvozanat: **faqat security origin**, **canary** guruh, reboot'ni nazorat ostida, yoki **immutable infra** (yangi image).

**Sozlash (Debian/Ubuntu):**
```bash
sudo apt install unattended-upgrades needrestart
sudo dpkg-reconfigure -plow unattended-upgrades
```
```
// /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades
Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins {
    "${distro_id}:${distro_codename}-security";
};
Unattended-Upgrade::Package-Blacklist { "postgresql-.*"; "docker-ce"; };
Unattended-Upgrade::Automatic-Reboot "false";
```
RHEL:
```ini
# /etc/dnf/automatic.conf
[commands]
upgrade_type = security
apply_updates = yes
```
```bash
systemctl enable --now dnf-automatic.timer
```

**Reboot kerakligini bilish:**
```bash
cat /var/run/reboot-required          # Debian
needs-restarting -r                   # RHEL
needrestart -r l                      # qaysi servis eski lib ishlatyapti
```

**Rollout modeli:**
```
canary (5% server, 1 kun) -> monitoring OK? -> qolgan 95%
                          -> xato? -> to'xtat, blacklist
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kernel yangilandi, lekin reboot yo'q — server hali zaif kernel'da. Livepatch (Ubuntu Pro, kpatch) yoki rejalashtirilgan reboot.
- Hamma serverda bir vaqtda — xato patch butun klasterni yiqitadi.
- Log/monitoring yo'q — nima yangilangani noma'lum (`/var/log/unattended-upgrades/`).

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi model — immutable: patch'lar bilan yangi image build qilinadi, test qilinadi va rolling replace bilan almashtiriladi. Server ichida yangilash bo'lsa — "cattle, not pets" emas, drift paydo bo'ladi.

31101.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Internal mirror / artifact repository build va deploy'ni **tashqi internetga bog'liqlikdan** ajratadi: offline build, tezlik, bugungi holat **snapshot**'i, paketlarni **skanerlash** va kim nimani ishlatayotganini nazorat qilish.

**Muammo:** Deploy kuni npm registry/Docker Hub ishlamay qoldi yoki rate limit — production build to'xtadi. Yoki upstream'dan paket o'chirildi (left-pad 2016). Yoki zararli versiya chiqdi va CI uni darhol tortdi.

**Arxitektura:**
```
CI / serverlar --> internal proxy (Artifactory/Nexus) --> internet
                     |  kesh, snapshot
                     |  skan (Xray/Trivy), allowlist
                     |  ichki paketlar (private)
```

**Vositalar:**
| Ehtiyoj | Vosita |
|---|---|
| Universal | JFrog Artifactory, Sonatype Nexus |
| apt | aptly, reprepro |
| rpm | Pulp, Satellite |
| Go | Athens, `GOPROXY` |
| Container | Harbor, registry pull-through cache |

```bash
export GOPROXY=https://goproxy.internal,direct
npm config set registry https://nexus.internal/repository/npm/
pip config set global.index-url https://nexus.internal/repository/pypi/simple
```

**Dependency confusion:** Ichki paketingiz `acme-utils` nomida. Hujumchi public npm'ga `acme-utils@99.0.0` chiqaradi — resolver kattaroq versiyani tanlaydi. Himoya: scope (`@acme/utils`), ichki nomlarni public'da rezerv qilish, proxy'da ichki nomlar uchun public'ni bloklash.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Mirror o'zi single point of failure — HA va backup kerak.
- `direct` fallback'ni qoldirish — proxy chetlab o'tiladi.
- Kesh hech qachon tozalanmaydi — disk to'ladi; retention policy.

**Senior nuqta:** Artifact repo — supply chain nazorat nuqtasi: bu yerda imzo tekshirish, SBOM saqlash va "faqat ruxsat etilgan" policy'ni bitta joyda qo'llaysan.

31102.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ishonch zanjirini har bo'g'inda tekshir: **manba** (hash/lock bilan qotirish), **build** (izolyatsiya, provenance — SLSA), **artefakt** (imzo — cosign, SBOM, CVE skan), **deploy** (faqat imzolangan va tekshirilgan narsa ishga tushadi). Va minimal base image — kam paket, kam hujum yuzasi.

**Hujum nuqtalari:**
```
dev -> source repo -> dependency'lar -> CI build -> registry -> cluster
  ^        ^              ^                ^           ^          ^
akkaunt  commit       typosquat,       CI token     image      imzosiz
o'g'irl. imzosiz      dep confusion,   o'g'irlash   almashtir. image
                      maintainer (xz)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# hash pin
pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
go mod verify
# SBOM + CVE
syft myimage:1.2 -o spdx-json > sbom.json
grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 myimage:1.2
# imzo (keyless, OIDC)
cosign sign ghcr.io/acme/app@sha256:...
cosign verify --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/acme/.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ghcr.io/acme/app@sha256:...
```
Deploy'da majburlash: Kyverno / Sigstore policy-controller — imzosiz image admission'da rad etiladi.
